name: WhatsApp (WAHA)
description: A WhatsApp inbox backed by your own WAHA instance. Agents can read it; sending asks you first unless you turn on automatic sending.

secrets.name: WAHA_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key of your WAHA instance (sent as X-Api-Key)

secrets.name: WAHA_WEBHOOK_HMAC
secrets.description: HMAC key configured in WAHA for webhooks. When set, every webhook is verified.

settings.label: WAHA address
settings.description: Where your WAHA instance listens, for example https://waha.example.com. Only this address is ever contacted.

settings.label: Always allow AI to send messages
settings.description: WARNING: when on, agents send WhatsApp messages to ANY chat as your account without asking you first, and a message cannot be unsent. Off by default: each message then needs your approval in Floq. Turn on only if you accept that risk.

settings.label: Assistant can message me (your WhatsApp number)
settings.description: Your own number in international format, for example +5511999999999. When set, the assistant can send you messages at this number without asking each time. Use Send test message below to check it.
